newsitem.title: UK: BRITAIN SEEKS BIDS ON 1.6 BLN STG STUDENT LOANS.
newsitem.headline: BRITAIN SEEKS BIDS ON 1.6 BLN STG STUDENT LOANS.

text.p: N M Rothschild & Sons Ltd will ask this week for indicative bids on 1.6 billion stg of student loans being sold by Britain, the merchant bank said in a statement on Monday.

Rothschild, the government's financial adviser, said the portfolio would be sold at face value but, because the loans were made below market rates, the government would provide an ongoing subsidy to the buyer.
Rothschild said it had identified 20 potential purchasers who would be asked to submit indicative bids by October 3 based on the level of this government subsidy.
Britain recently confirmed it would sell 1.6 billion stg of student loans this financial year and 1.5 billion stg in 1998/99 originated under a scheme in operation since 1990.
